answer.summary: A snug Nordic festival town on level ground: one street of lots around a central festival square, with a great festival hall, four homes, a bakery, a toymaker's workshop, a chapel of lights on high ground, a sleigh stable at the edge and a warming hut. A frozen pond ice rink sits beside the town. The decorated tree, banners and lanterns come with the style.
